testCases.expectedOutput: Standard engine water-ingress damage is covered under Add-on TA33 (Engine Secure), but this cover explicitly does NOT apply to electric vehicles. For electric vehicles, water-related battery/charging equipment damage (including ingress of water while charging) is instead covered under Add-on TA27 (Electric Surge Secure), which covers arcing, self-heating, leakage of electricity, or short-circuiting including water ingress while charging, up to the vehicle's IDV. Depreciation on a replaced battery can further be recovered under TA28 (Depreciation Allowance - Battery), provided the battery cost is included in the IDV.
